InfoBlock1.title: About Our Company
InfoBlock1.content: We specialize in the professional cleaning and disinfection of wall-mounted air conditioners in Gush Dan for over 5 years. Our team of certified technicians uses only high-quality, hypoallergenic products and modern equipment to ensure maximum efficiency and safety for your home or office.

InfoBlock2.title: Why Cleaning and Disinfection of Your Air Conditioner Are Important

line1.title: Air Quality and Health
line1.content: Over time, wall-mounted air conditioners accumulate dust, mold, bacteria, and allergens. If regular cleaning is not performed (at least once a year), all of this is circulated throughout the room with the airflow. As a result, respiratory tracts become irritated, frequent colds, allergic reactions, and overall well-being deterioration may occur.

line2.title: Energy Efficiency
line2.content: Clogged filters and the evaporator force the compressor to work harder, causing energy consumption to increase by 10–25%. Regular maintenance helps reduce electricity bills and extend the equipment’s lifespan.

line3.title: Prolonging the Life of Your Air Conditioner
line3.content: Accumulated dirt interferes with the normal operation of the fan and heat exchanger: parts wear out faster, noises or refrigerant leaks may occur. Proper cleaning and disinfection protect the air conditioner components and extend the equipment’s service life by several years.

InfoBlock3.title: How the Cleaning and Disinfection Process Works

steps.title: Inspection and Disassembly
steps.content: Our technician arrives at the agreed time, disconnects the unit, and carefully disassembles the filters, casing, and components for further cleaning.

steps.title: Internal Component Cleaning
steps.content: Filters are washed and disinfected with special hypoallergenic products. The heat exchanger (evaporator) is treated with steam or gentle water pressure to remove dust, mold, and deposits.

steps.title: Drain System Cleaning
steps.content: Drain channels and the condensate tray are flushed to prevent clogs and eliminate standing water and odors.

steps.title: Outdoor Unit Cleaning
steps.content: The outdoor unit’s heat exchanger (condenser) and fan are cleaned of dust and dirt using high pressure. The radiator fins are inspected and cleared of debris.

steps.title: Disinfection and Reassembly
steps.content: Internal components are treated with an antiseptic solution to completely eliminate bacteria and mold. Then all parts are reassembled, filters are installed, and the air conditioner’s operation is tested.

items.title: 30-Day Quality Guarantee
items.content: If you notice reduced performance, unusual noises, or odors after service, we will return free of charge (provided the issue is not due to mechanical damage).

items.title: Safe Products
items.content: All disinfectants and cleaning agents are certified hypoallergenic. We do not use harsh acids or toxic chemicals.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
items.content: No hidden fees. If you are located within Gush Dan, there are no additional surcharges.

items.title: Professional Technicians
items.content: Our team consists of certified specialists with over 3 years of experience. We continuously train in new cleaning and disinfection methods and use state-of-the-art equipment.

items.title: Home Wall-Mounted Air Conditioners
items.content: Recommended to service once a year.

items.title: Office Air Conditioners (operating ≥8 hours/day)
items.content: It is advisable to clean twice a year (spring and late summer) to prevent overload and bacterial buildup.

items.title: Households with Allergies and Young Children
items.content: Better to perform the procedure every 6 months for maximum safety.
